.eyebrow{color:#f3d48a;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(243,212,138,.5);padding-top:12px;display:inline-block}
.ttl{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(46px,8.2vw,104px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff3c9 0%,#efc66a 40%,#b9801f 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2.5px #6b4310;paint-order:stroke fill;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 0 rgba(50,25,5,.7)) drop-shadow(0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.45))}
.ttl2{display:block;font-style:italic;font-size:.52em;margin-top:8px;-webkit-text-stroke:1.8px #6b4310}
.hero-in .sub{max-width:430px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);margin:22px 0 26px;font-size:15.5px}
.hbtns{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-h{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--yellow);color:var(--brown);border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 24px;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}
.btn-h.ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.hcap{position:absolute;right:32px;bottom:38px;max-width:230px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;opacity:.92;text-align:left;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:12px}
.page{padding:34px 40px 56px}
.head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 0 20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.head h1{font:800 clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px) 'Playfair Display',serif;letter-spacing:-.01em}.head h1.sm{font:800 22px 'Manrope',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.icon{flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}.icon.sm{width:32px;height:32px}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;padding:20px}
.card.sand{background:var(--sand);border-color:transparent}.card.dark{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#5b3a28,#34200f);color:#fff;border:0}
.stat span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.card.dark .stat span,.card.dark small,.card.dark .muted{color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
.stat b{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;display:block;margin-top:2px}.stat small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px}
.pos{color:var(--ok)}.neg{color:var(--red)}
.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.kv:last-child{border-bottom:0}.kv span{color:var(--muted)}.kv b{text-align:right;font-weight:600}
.empty{color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:28px 14px;border:1.5px dashed #d6c4ae;border-radius:22px}
.lab{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold-d);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.h2{font:800 clamp(26px,3.2vw,40px)/1.12 'Playfair Display',serif;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0 0 12px}
.sec{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:26px 2px 12px;gap:10px}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:12px 22px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brown);color:#fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn.gold{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--brown)}.btn.ghost{background:var(--sand);color:var(--brown)}.btn.line{background:transparent;border:1px solid #d6c4ae;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.danger{background:var(--red-t);color:var(--red)}.btn.ok{background:var(--ok-t);color:var(--ok)}.btn.sm{padding:8px 15px;font-size:13px}.btn.block{width:100%}
.actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:20px}.actions .btn{flex:1}.actions.wrap .btn{flex:1 1 40%}
label.f{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);margin:13px 0 5px}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid #dccdb9;border-radius:14px;padding:11px 14px;outline:none}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,162,76,.25)}
.chk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0;cursor:pointer}.chk input{width:18px;height:18px;padding:0;accent-color:var(--gold-d)}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dccdb9;border-radius:999px;padding:0 16px;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--muted);max-width:520px}.search input{border:0;box-shadow:none!important;padding:12px 0;background:transparent}
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:#eadfce;border-radius:999px;padding:4px;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.seg button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px}.seg button.on{background:var(--brown);color:#fff}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 12px;scrollbar-width:none}.chips::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.chip{flex:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid #dccdb9;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.chip.on{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--brown);border-color:var(--yellow);font-weight:800}.chip i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:7px}
.tag{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--sand);color:var(--gold-d);white-space:nowrap}
.tag.ok{background:var(--ok-t);color:var(--ok)}.tag.warn{background:var(--warn-t);color:var(--warn)}.tag.red{background:var(--red-t);color:var(--red)}.tag.blue{background:var(--blue-t);color:var(--blue)}.tag.gray{background:#eadfce;color:var(--muted)}
.item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer}.item:hover{border-color:#cdb597}
.av{flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--sand);color:var(--gold-d);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;overflow:hidden}
.av.lg{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;font-size:16px}.av img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.av.in{background:var(--ok-t);color:var(--ok)}.av.out{background:var(--red-t);color:var(--red)}
.item .t{font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.item .s{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.item .r{text-align:right;flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;text-align:left;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:14px 16px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px}
.menu .mi{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sand);color:var(--gold-d);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}.menu small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px}
/* tiles de foto */
.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.8fr);gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.tile{position:relative;border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;isolation:isolate;min-height:300px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#d9b06a,#8a5a28);cursor:pointer}
.tile img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-2;transition:transform .6s}.tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.tile::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(32,17,10,.7),rgba(32,17,10,.05) 60%)}
.tile .in{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:20px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}
.tile .in b{display:block;font:800 20px/1.15 'Playfair Display',serif}.tile .in small{opacity:.9}
.rb{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:#fff;color:var(--brown);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.pilltag{display:inline-block;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:var(--brown);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px}
.bnav{display:none}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:28px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:var(--brown);color:#fff;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;z-index:80;max-width:90%;text-align:center}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}#toast.err{background:var(--red)}
.sheet-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(32,17,10,.58);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:50}
.sheet{background:#fff;width:100%;max-width:600px;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;border-radius:28px 28px 0 0;padding:22px 22px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));animation:up .18s ease-out}
@keyframes up{from{transform:translateY(24px);opacity:0}}
@media (min-width:700px){.sheet-bg{align-items:center}.sheet{border-radius:28px}}
/* agenda */
.cal-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.ctitle{min-width:170px;text-align:center;font-size:17px}
.cal{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden}
.cal-h{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);background:var(--sand);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gold-d);text-align:center;padding:11px 0}
.cal-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr)}
.cd{min-height:110px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding:7px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0}.cd:nth-child(7n+1){border-left:0}.cd.off{background:#fbf8f3;color:#b8a995}
.cd .dn{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;width:28px;height:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%}.cd.today .dn{background:var(--brown);color:#fff}
.ev{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-left:3px solid var(--sc);background:var(--sb);color:var(--st);border-radius:7px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;cursor:pointer}
.dots{display:none;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sc);display:inline-block}.more{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.st-agendado{--sc:#4a7fbf;--sb:#e1eaf6;--st:#27508a}.st-confirmado{--sc:#3f8a5a;--sb:#dcefe3;--st:#256040}.st-concluido{--sc:#a3a09b;--sb:#ece8e4;--st:#6b6762}.st-faltou{--sc:#d9485f;--sb:#fbe3e6;--st:#a1283c}.st-cancelado{--sc:#a3a09b;--sb:#ece8e4;--st:#8a8681}
.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px;background:var(--sc)}
.hb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:9px 0;font-size:13px}.hb span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.hb .bar{height:9px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--sand);overflow:hidden}.hb .bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--gold);border-radius:5px}
/* mapa facial */
.mapwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,260px) 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.face{width:100%;height:auto;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbf3ea,#f1e2d0);border-radius:20px;cursor:crosshair;display:block}
.face .l{fill:none;stroke:#a98a70;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.face g{pointer-events:none}
.prow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12px 28px 1fr 74px 28px 32px;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}
.prow i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%}.prow input{padding:6px 8px;border-radius:10px}
/* odontograma */
.tools{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--bg);padding-top:8px}
.odo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}
@media (min-width:700px){.odo{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px 0}.quad:nth-child(odd){border-right:2px solid var(--line);padding-right:12px}.quad:nth-child(even){padding-left:12px}}
.quad-t{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 4px 2px}
.teeth{display:flex}.teeth.r{justify-content:flex-end}.teeth.l{justify-content:flex-start}
.tooth{flex:0 0 12.5%;min-width:0;text-align:center}.tooth svg{width:100%;max-width:56px;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto;cursor:pointer}
.tooth .n{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--muted);background:none;border:0;padding:3px 0 2px;cursor:pointer}
.finds{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.find{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
/* anexos */
.att-kinds{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0 16px}
.att-kinds button{border:1px solid #dccdb9;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:20px;padding:12px 8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;flex:1;min-width:112px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}.att-kinds button:hover{background:var(--sand)}
.att-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px}
.att-card{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.att-card .th{aspect-ratio:3/4;background:var(--sand)}.att-card .th img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.att-card .cap{padding:8px 10px}.att-card .cap b{display:block;font-size:12.5px}.att-card .cap small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.att-card input{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;width:22px;height:22px;padding:0;accent-color:var(--gold-d)}
.cmp{position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/4;overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px;background:#000}.cmp img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.cmp .lb{position:absolute;top:10px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;z-index:2}
.cmp-r{width:100%;margin-top:12px;padding:0;accent-color:var(--gold-d)}
/* orçamento */
.bi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}.bi .g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 2fr;gap:8px;margin-top:4px}.bi small{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-top:6px}
.tot{border-top:1px dashed #d6c4ae;margin-top:14px;padding-top:8px}.tot .kv{border:0;padding:4px 0}.tot .big{font-size:24px}
.rule{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 80px auto 32px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}.rule label{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.evo{cursor:pointer}.evo-sub{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:14px}.evo-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
#printdoc{display:none}
@media print{body{background:#fff;padding:0}#app,#toast,#modal-root{display:none!important}#printdoc{display:block;padding:24px;font-family:Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px}#printdoc table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:14px 0}#printdoc th,#printdoc td{border-bottom:1px solid #999;padding:6px 4px;text-align:left}#printdoc .r{text-align:right}#printdoc .sign{margin-top:70px;display:flex;gap:40px}#printdoc .sign div{flex:1;border-top:1px solid #000;text-align:center;padding-top:4px;font-size:12px}}
@media (max-width:1050px){.pills{display:none}.duo{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.duo>.card{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media (max-width:899px){
 body{padding:0}.frame{border-radius:0;min-height:100vh}
 .topbar{padding:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 16px 14px}.sbtn{display:none}.cta{margin-left:auto}
 .band.hero{min-height:640px}.band .art{object-position:70% 18%}
 .band.hero::after{background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(32,17,10,.95) 0%,rgba(32,17,10,.8) 40%,rgba(32,17,10,.15) 70%,rgba(32,17,10,.5) 100%)}
 .hero-in{padding:28px 20px 36px}.hcap{display:none}
 .page{padding:22px 16px calc(112px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
 .bnav{display:flex;position:fixed;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(40,20,10,.25);z-index:20;padding:6px;gap:2px}
 .bnav button{flex:1;position:relative;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 2px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:18px}
 .bnav button.on{background:var(--brown);color:#fff}.bnav .nb{position:absolute;top:2px;right:14px;font-size:10px;padding:0 6px}
 #toast{bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}.list{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .cd{min-height:60px;padding:4px}.evs{display:none}.dots{display:flex}.mapwrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tile{min-height:260px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"></div><div id="modal-root"></div><div id="toast"></div><div id="printdoc"></div>
<script>
/* ================= utilidades ================= */
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const esc=s=>String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const uid=()=>crypto.randomUUID?crypto.randomUUID():'i'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9);
const iso=d=>d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
const today=()=>iso(new Date());
const addDays=(s,n)=>{const d=new Date(s+'T00:00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()+n);return iso(d);};
const addMonths=(s,n)=>{const [y,m,d]=s.split('-').map(Number),dt=new Date(y,m-1+n,1),l=new Date(dt.getFullYear(),dt.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();dt.setDate(Math.min(d,l));return iso(dt);};
const dd=(a,b)=>Math.round((new Date(a+'T00:00:00')-new Date(b+'T00:00:00'))/864e5);
const fdate=s=>s?String(s).slice(0,10).split('-').reverse().join('/'):'';
const money=v=>Number(v||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'});
const sum=(a,f)=>a.reduce((s,x)=>s+(+(f?f(x):x.value)||0),0);
const digits=s=>String(s||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
const initials=n=>String(n||'?').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).map(w=>w[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
const short=n=>{const w=String(n||'').trim().split(/\s+/);return w.length>1?w[0]+' '+w[w.length-1][0]+'.':(w[0]||'');};
const rel=d=>{const n=dd(d,today());return n<0?`há ${-n} dia${n<-1?'s':''}`:n===0?'hoje':n===1?'amanhã':`em ${n} dias`;};
const waLink=(ph,t)=>{let d=digits(ph);if(d&&d.length<=11)d='55'+d;return 'https://wa.me/'+d+(t?'?text='+encodeURIComponent(t):'');};
const fill=(t,o)=>String(t).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g,(_,k)=>o[k]==null?'':o[k]);
const MONTHS=['Janeiro','Fevereiro','Março','Abril','Maio','Junho','Julho','Agosto','Setembro','Outubro','Novembro','Dezembro'];
const DOW=['Dom','Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','Sáb'];
const WD=['domingo','segunda-feira','terça-feira','quarta-feira','quinta-feira','sexta-feira','sábado'];
const mlabel=m=>MONTHS[+m.slice(5,7)-1]+' de '+m.slice(0,4);
const shiftMonth=(m,n)=>iso(new Date(+m.slice(0,4),+m.slice(5,7)-1+n,1)).slice(0,7);
const val=id=>{const e=document.getElementById('f_'+id);return e?e.value:'';};
const num=id=>parseFloat(String(val(id)).replace(',','.'))||0;
const opts=(l,sel)=>l.map(o=>{const [v,t]=Array.isArray(o)?o:[o,o];return `<option value="${esc(v)}" ${v===sel?'selected':''}>${esc(t)}</option>`;}).join('');
const empty=m=>`<div class="empty">${m}</div>`;
const lst=h=>`<div class="list">${h}</div>`;
const IC={home:'<path d="M3 11.5 12 4l9 7.5"/><path d="M5.5 10v10h13V10"/>',users:'<circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.5"/><path d="M2.5 20c0-3.6 2.9-6 6.5-6s6.5 2.4 6.5 6"/><path d="M16 4.6a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 6.8M18 14.6c2 .6 3.5 2.4 3.5 5.4"/>',calendar:'<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4"/>',bell:'<path d="M6 17V11a6 6 0 0 1 12 0v6l1.5 2h-15z"/><path d="M10 21h4"/>',dots:'<circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.7"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.7"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.7"/>',plus:'<path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>',back:'<path d="M15 5l-7 7 7 7"/>',chev:'<path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>',chevd:'<path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/>',arrow:'<path d="M7 17 17 7M8 7h9v9"/>',search:'<circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="M20 20l-4-4"/>',trash:'<path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3M6 7l1 13h10l1-13"/>',edit:'<path d="M4 20h4L19 9l-4-4L4 16z"/>',box:'<path d="M3 8l9-5 9 5v8l-9 5-9-5z"/><path d="M3 8l9 5 9-5M12 13v8"/>',wallet:'<rect x="2.5" y="6" width="19" height="13" rx="3"/><path d="M2.5 10h19"/><circle cx="17" cy="14.5" r="1.2"/>',chart:'<path d="M4 20V4M4 20h16M8 16v-5M12 16V8M16 16v-3"/>',camera:'<path d="M4 8h3l1.6-2.5h6.8L17 8h3a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v10a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"/><circle cx="12" cy="13.5" r="3.6"/>',image:'<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="2"/><path d="m4 18 5-5 3.5 3.5L17 12l3 3"/>',send:'<path d="M12 15V3M8 7l4-4 4 4M5 14v6h14v-6"/>',save:'<path d="M12 3v12M8 11l4 4 4-4M5 20h14"/>',gear:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2.5v3M12 18.5v3M2.5 12h3M18.5 12h3M5.3 5.3l2.1 2.1M16.6 16.6l2.1 2.1M18.7 5.3l-2.1 2.1M7.4 16.6l-2.1 2.1"/>',x:'<path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/>',spark:'<path d="M12 3l1.8 5.2L19 10l-5.2 1.8L12 17l-1.8-5.2L5 10l5.2-1.8zM19 16l.8 2.2L22 19l-2.2.8L19 22l-.8-2.2L16 19l2.2-.8z"/>',file:'<path d="M6 3h8l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4M9 12h6M9 16h6"/>',repeat:'<path d="M4 11V9a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h11l-3-3M20 13v2a3 3 0 0 1-3 3H6l3 3"/>'};
const ic=(n,s=20)=>`<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${s}" height="${s}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${IC[n]||''}</svg>`;
let tt;function toast(m,err){const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=m;t.className='show'+(err?' err':'');clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>{t.className='';},3000);}
function modal(h){$('#modal-root').innerHTML=`<div class="sheet-bg" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeModal()"><div class="sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">${h}</div></div>`;hydrate();}
function closeModal(){$('#modal-root').innerHTML='';}
function download(name,text,type){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text],{type}));a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1500);}
function printDoc(h){$('#printdoc').innerHTML=h;window.print();}
const photoTag=(src,pos)=>`<img src="${src}" alt="" style="object-position:${pos||'50% 30%'}" decoding="async" onerror="this.remove()">`;

/* ================= imagens (IndexedDB) ================= */
const idb=()=>new Promise((res,rej)=>{const r=indexedDB.open('harmo_img',1);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>r.result.createObjectStore('i');r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>rej(r.error);});
async function imgPut(id,b){const d=await idb();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const t=d.transaction('i','readwrite');t.objectStore('i').put(b,id);t.oncomplete=res;t.onerror=()=>rej(t.error);});}
async function imgGet(id){const d=await idb();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const q=d.transaction('i').objectStore('i').get(id);q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result);q.onerror=()=>rej(q.error);});}
async function imgDel(id){if(!id)return;try{const d=await idb();d.transaction('i','readwrite').objectStore('i').delete(id);delete URLS[id];}catch(e){}}
const URLS={};
async function imgUrl(id){if(URLS[id])return URLS[id];const b=await imgGet(id);return b?(URLS[id]=URL.createObjectURL(b)):'';}
function hydrate(){document.querySelectorAll('img[data-img]:not([src])').forEach(async el=>{try{const u=await imgUrl(el.dataset.img);if(u)el.src=u;}catch(e){}});}
function compress(file,max,q){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const fr=new FileReader();fr.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('Falha ao ler o arquivo'));fr.onload=()=>{const im=new Image();im.onerror=()=>rej(new Error('Imagem inválida'));im.onload=()=>{const k=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(im.width,im.height)),cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.round(im.width*k);cv.height=Math.round(im.height*k);cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,cv.width,cv.height);cv.toBlob(b=>b?res(b):rej(new Error('Falha ao processar')),'image/jpeg',q);};im.src=fr.result;};fr.readAsDataURL(file);});}

/* ================= protocolos padrão ================= */
const POS_ALARME='Procure atendimento imediatamente se houver dor intensa, pele esbranquiçada ou com manchas arroxeadas, alteração da visão, febre ou piora rápida do inchaço.';
const DEF_PROT=[
 {key:'toxina',name:'Toxina botulínica',unit:'U',price:1200,rules:[{label:'Avaliação / retoque',days:15,nova:false},{label:'Reaplicação',days:120,nova:true}],pos:'Não deite e evite esforço físico intenso por 4 horas. Não massageie a região por 24 horas. O efeito aparece em 3 a 7 dias e o pico costuma ocorrer em cerca de 15 dias.'},
 {key:'preenchimento',name:'Preenchimento com ácido hialurônico',unit:'mL',price:1800,rules:[{label:'Avaliação',days:30,nova:false},{label:'Manutenção',days:270,nova:true}],pos:'Evite massagear a área, calor intenso (sauna, sol) e exercício intenso por 48 horas. Inchaço e pequenos hematomas leves podem ocorrer nos primeiros dias.'},
 {key:'bioestimulador',name:'Bioestimulador de colágeno',unit:'mL',price:2500,rules:[{label:'Próxima sessão',days:45,nova:true},{label:'Manutenção anual',days:365,nova:true}],pos:'Siga a massagem orientada pelo profissional, se indicada. Evite calor intenso e exercício intenso por 48 horas. O resultado é gradual, ao longo de semanas.'},
 {key:'skinbooster',name:'Skinbooster',unit:'mL',price:900,rules:[{label:'Próxima sessão',days:30,nova:true},{label:'Manutenção',days:180,nova:true}],pos:'Pequenas pápulas e vermelhidão duram algumas horas ou dias. Evite maquiagem por 12 horas, use protetor solar e hidrate bem a pele.'},
 {key:'fios',name:'Fios de PDO',unit:'un',price:1500,rules:[{label:'Avaliação',days:30,nova:false},{label:'Manutenção',days:180,nova:true}],pos:'Evite movimentos faciais exagerados, massagens e dormir de bruços por cerca de 2 semanas, ou conforme a orientação do profissional.'},
 {key:'peeling',name:'Peeling químico',unit:'sessão',price:350,rules:[{label:'Próxima sessão',days:21,nova:true}],pos:'Não remova a descamação manualmente. Use protetor solar rigorosamente e hidratante conforme a orientação.'},
 {key:'microagulhamento',name:'Microagulhamento',unit:'sessão',price:450,rules:[{label:'Próxima sessão',days:30,nova:true}],pos:'Evite sol, maquiagem e exercícios por 24 horas. Use protetor solar e os cosméticos prescritos.'},
 {key:'enzimas',name:'Enzimas / papada',unit:'mL',price:700,rules:[{label:'Próxima sessão',days:30,nova:true}],pos:'Inchaço local é esperado por alguns dias. Evite calor intenso e siga a orientação de compressas do profissional.'},
 {key:'outro',name:'Outro procedimento',unit:'un',price:0,rules:[],pos:''}];
const DEF_TPL={
 retorno:'Olá, {nome}! Aqui é da {clinica}. Está chegando a hora do seu retorno ({retorno}) do procedimento de {procedimento}. Vamos agendar um horário?',
 pos:'Olá, {nome}! Tudo bem após o procedimento de {procedimento}? Seguem as orientações:\n\n{orientacoes}',
 reativ:'Olá, {nome}! Aqui é da {clinica}. Faz um tempinho desde o seu último atendimento. Quer agendar uma avaliação para revisarmos seus resultados?',
 lembrete:'Olá, {nome}! Confirmando sua consulta em {data} às {hora} na {clinica}. Podemos confirmar?',
 recall:'Olá, {nome}! Aqui é da {clinica}. Estamos entrando em contato sobre o produto utilizado no seu procedimento de {procedimento} em {data} (lote {lote}). Pedimos que entre em contato conosco para uma orientação importante.'};
const AN=[['gestante','Gestante / lactante'],['alergia','Alergias relevantes'],['anticoag','Anticoagulante / AAS'],['queloide','Tendência a queloide'],['herpes','Herpes labial recorrente'],['autoimune','Doença autoimune'],['isotret','Isotretinoína recente'],['infec','Infecção ativa na região']];
const PT={toxina:['Toxina','#b76e79'],preench:['Preenchedor','#2f6fb5'],bio:['Bioestimulador','#d99a2b'],fios:['Fios','#3a8a5c'],skin:['Skinbooster','#8a5cc0'],outro:['Outro','#64748b']};
const PU={toxina:'U',preench:'mL',bio:'mL',fios:'un',skin:'mL',outro:''};
const PQ={toxina:2,preench:.1,bio:.2,fios:1,skin:.1,outro:1};
const P2T={toxina:'toxina',preenchimento:'preench',bioestimulador:'bio',fios:'fios',skinbooster:'skin'};
const RST={pendente:['Pendente','warn'],contatado:['Contatado','blue'],agendado:['Agendado','ok'],concluido:['Concluído','gray'],descartado:['Descartado','gray']};
const AST={agendado:['Agendado','blue'],confirmado:['Confirmado','ok'],concluido:['Concluído','gray'],faltou:['Faltou','red'],cancelado:['Cancelado','gray']};
const PST={planejado:['Planejado','blue'],andamento:['Em andamento','warn'],concluido:['Concluído','ok']};
const BST={pendente:['Pendente','warn'],aprovado:['Aprovado','ok'],recusado:['Recusado','red']};
const CAT_IN=['Toxina botulínica','Preenchimento','Bioestimulador','Skinbooster','Fios','Procedimento','Outros'],CAT_OUT=['Produtos / insumos','Aluguel','Salários','Impostos','Marketing','Equipamentos','Contas','Outros'];
const METHODS=['Pix','Dinheiro','Cartão de crédito','Cartão de débito','Boleto','Transferência'];
const ATT=[['antes','Antes','camera'],['depois','Depois','camera'],['radiografia','Radiografia','image'],['ficha','Ficha clínica em papel','file'],['foto','Foto do paciente','camera'],['outro','Outro documento','file']];
const attLabel=k=>(ATT.find(x=>x[0]===k)||[,k])[1];

/* ================= dados ================= */
const LS='harmonizacao_v2';
const EMPTY=()=>({patients:[],sessions:[],retornos:[],stock:[],appts:[],tx:[],protocols:[],photos:[],evolutions:[],plans:[],budgets:[],cfg:{}});
let S=EMPTY();
function loadLocal(){try{const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS));if(d)S={...EMPTY(),...d};}catch(e){}if(!S.protocols.length)S.protocols=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEF_PROT));}
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(LS,JSON.stringify(S));}catch(e){toast('Armazenamento cheio. Exporte um backup.',true);}}
function up(kind,o){const a=S[kind],i=a.findIndex(x=>x.id===o.id);if(i<0){o.created_at=o.created_at||new Date().toISOString();a.push(o);}else a[i]={...a[i],...o};persist();return S[kind].find(x=>x.id===o.id);}
function rm(kind,id){S[kind]=S[kind].filter(x=>x.id!==id);persist();}
const pat=id=>S.patients.find(x=>x.id===id);
const pname=id=>(pat(id)||{}).name||'—';
const protOf=k=>S.protocols.find(p=>p.key===k)||S.protocols[S.protocols.length-1]||{key:'outro',name:'Procedimento',unit:'un',rules:[]};
const protName=k=>protOf(k).name;
const CL=()=>S.cfg.clinic||{};
const tpl=k=>(S.cfg.tpl&&S.cfg.tpl[k])||DEF_TPL[k];
const clinicName=()=>CL().name||'nossa clínica';
const riskList=p=>AN.filter(([k])=>p.an&&p.an[k]).map(x=>x[1]);
const OPEN=['pendente','contatado','agendado'];
const rOpen=()=>S.retornos.filter(r=>OPEN.includes(r.status));
const rAlert=()=>rOpen().filter(r=>r.status!=='agendado'&&r.due<=today());
const sAlerts=()=>S.stock.map(s=>{const d=s.validade?dd(s.validade,today()):null,f=[];if(d!=null&&d<0)f.push('Vencido');else if(d!=null&&d<=60)f.push('Vence em '+d+' dias');if(+s.min>0&&+s.qty<=+s.min)f.push('Estoque baixo');return {s,f};}).filter(x=>x.f.length);
const apptsOn=d=>S.appts.filter(a=>a.date===d).sort((a,b)=>String(a.time).localeCompare(String(b.time)));
function genRetornos(ses){
  S.retornos.filter(r=>r.patient_id===ses.patient_id&&r.proc===ses.proc&&OPEN.includes(r.status)&&r.nova&&r.session_id!==ses.id).forEach(r=>up('retornos',{id:r.id,status:'concluido',done_at:today()}));
  return (protOf(ses.proc).rules||[]).map(r=>up('retornos',{id:uid(),patient_id:ses.patient_id,session_id:ses.id,proc:ses.proc,label:r.label,nova:!!r.nova,due:addDays(ses.date,+r.days),status:'pendente'}));
}
function delPatientData(id){
  const p=pat(id);if(p&&p.avatar)imgDel(p.avatar);
  S.photos.filter(x=>x.patient_id===id).forEach(x=>imgDel(x.id));
  ['photos','sessions','retornos','appts','evolutions','plans','budgets'].forEach(k=>{S[k]=S[k].filter(x=>x.patient_id!==id);});
  S.tx.forEach(x=>{if(x.patient_id===id)x.patient_id=null;});S.patients=S.patients.filter(x=>x.id!==id);persist();
}

/* ================= notificações ================= */
function checkNotify(force){
  if(!('Notification' in window)||Notification.permission!=='granted')return;
  const t=today();if(!force&&S.cfg.lastNotify===t)return;
  const a=rAlert(),s=sAlerts();if(!a.length&&!s.length)return;
  const body=[a.length?a.length+' retorno(s) para contatar':'',s.length?s.length+' alerta(s) de estoque':''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  try{new Notification('Harmonização · Gestão clínica',{body,tag:'harmo-'+t});}catch(e){}
  S.cfg.lastNotify=t;persist();
}
async function askNotif(){
  if(!('Notification' in window))return toast('Este navegador não suporta notificações.',true);
  const r=await Notification.requestPermission();toast(r==='granted'?'Notificações ativadas.':'Permissão não concedida.',r!=='granted');
  if(r==='granted')checkNotify(true);render();
}

/* ================= estrutura ================= */
const V={screen:'home',pid:null,ptab:'dados',q:'',month:today().slice(0,7),ftype:'todas',adate:today(),rfilter:'alerta',rtab:'abertos',period:6,ses:null,ptool:'toxina',otool:'carie',dec:false,sel:[],pkind:'antes',av:null,bud:null,bfilter:'todos',from:'list',txType:'entrada',lotq:''};
function nav(s,o){Object.assign(V,o||{});V.screen=s;render();window.scrollTo(0,0);}
document.addEventListener('click',()=>document.querySelectorAll('.dd.open').forEach(d=>d.classList.remove('open')));
function toggleDd(e){e.stopPropagation();e.currentTarget.parentElement.classList.toggle('open');}
const avIn=p=>p&&p.avatar?`<img data-img="${p.avatar}" alt="">`:esc(initials(p&&p.name));
function item(o){return `<div class="item" ${o.click?`onclick="${o.click}" role="button" tabindex="0"`:''}><div class="av ${o.cls||''}">${o.av}</div><div class="sp"><div class="t">${o.t}</div><div class="s">${o.s||''}</div></div><div class="r">${o.r||''}</div></div>`;}
const head=(title,back,right)=>`<div class="head">${back?`<button class="icon" onclick="${back}" aria-label="Voltar">${ic('back',22)}</button>`:''}<h1 class="sp">${title}</h1>${right||''}</div>`;
function render(){
  const map={home:scrHome,patients:scrPatients,patient:scrPatient,session:scrSession,agenda:scrAgenda,ret:scrRet,stock:scrStock,fin:scrFin,reports:scrReports,prot:scrProt,more:scrMore,budgets:scrBudgets,budget:scrBudget};
  const body=(map[V.screen]||scrHome)();
  const topOn={patient:'patients',session:'patients'}[V.screen]||V.screen;
  const botOn={home:'home',patients:'patients',patient:'patients',session:'patients',budget:'patients',agenda:'agenda',ret:'ret'}[V.screen]||'more';
  const nA=rAlert().length,badge=nA?`<span class="nb">${nA}</span>`:'';
  const top=[['home','Início'],['patients','Pacientes'],['agenda','Agenda'],['ret','Retornos'+(nA?' '+badge:'')],['stock','Estoque'],['fin','Financeiro']];
  const ban=nA&&V.screen!=='ret'?`<button class="banner" onclick="nav('ret',{rtab:'abertos',rfilter:'alerta'})">${nA} retorno${nA>1?'s':''} para contatar (vencidos ou de hoje). Toque para ver.</button>`:'';
  const hero=V.screen==='home';
  const bar=`<div class="topbar"><div class="brand" onclick="nav('home')">${ic('spark',28)}<div><b>Harmonização</b><small>${esc(CL().name||'Gestão clínica')}</small></div></div>
  <nav class="pills">${top.map(([k,l])=>`<button class="${topOn===k?'on':''}" onclick="nav('${k}')">${l}</button>`).join('')}
  <div class="dd"><button onclick="toggleDd(event)">Gestão ${ic('chevd',14)}</button><div class="pop"><button onclick="nav('budgets')">Orçamentos</button><button onclick="nav('reports')">Relatórios</button><button onclick="nav('prot')">Protocolos e retornos</button><button onclick="clinicForm()">Clínica e mensagens</button><button onclick="nav('more')">Backup e notificações</button></div></div></nav>
  <button class="sbtn" onclick="nav('patients')">${ic('search',16)} Buscar paciente</button>
  <button class="cta" onclick="apptForm()">Agendar <span class="ar">${ic('arrow',15)}</span></button></div>`;
  const heroHtml=`<header class="band hero">${photoTag('capa.jpg','62% 22%').replace('<img','<img class="art"')}${bar}
   <div class="hero-in"><p class="eyebrow">Pacientes · Prontuário · Retornos · Lotes</p><h1 class="ttl">Harmonização<span class="ttl2">Gestão clínica</span></h1>
   <p class="sub">Mapa facial, rastreabilidade de lotes, fotos de antes e depois e avisos de retorno no tempo certo.</p>
   <div class="hbtns"><button class="btn-h" onclick="newSession()">${ic('plus',16)} Nova sessão</button><button class="btn-h ghost" onclick="patientForm()">Novo paciente</button></div></div>
   <div class="hcap">Cuidado personalizado e acompanhamento de cada resultado.</div></header>`;
  $('#app').innerHTML=`<div class="frame">${hero?heroHtml:`<header class="band">${bar}</header>`}<main class="page">${ban}${body}</main></div>
  <nav class="bnav">${[['home','Início','home'],['patients','Pacientes','users'],['agenda','Agenda','calendar'],['ret','Retornos','bell'],['more','Mais','dots']].map(([k,l,i])=>`<button class="${botOn===k?'on':''}" onclick="nav('${k}')">${ic(i,22)}${l}${k==='ret'&&nA?`<span class="nb">${nA}</span>`:''}</button>`).join('')}</nav>`;
  document.title=(nA?`(${nA}) `:'')+'Harmonização · Gestão clínica';hydrate();
}

/* ================= início ================= */
function scrHome(){
  const t=today(),m=t.slice(0,7),dt=new Date(),h=dt.getHours();
  const hoje=apptsOn(t),al=rAlert().sort((a,b)=>a.due.localeCompare(b.due));
  const inM=S.tx.filter(x=>(x.date||'').slice(0,7)===m);
  const fat=sum(inM.filter(x=>x.type==='entrada'&&x.status==='pago')),desp=sum(inM.filter(x=>x.type==='despesa'&&x.status==='pago'));
  const rec=S.tx.filter(x=>x.type==='entrada'&&x.status==='pendente'),sa=sAlerts();
  const bd=S.patients.filter(p=>p.birth&&p.birth.slice(5,7)===m.slice(5,7)).sort((a,b)=>a.birth.slice(8)-b.birth.slice(8));
  const prox7=rOpen().filter(r=>r.status!=='agendado'&&r.due>t&&r.due<=addDays(t,7)).length;
  return `<div class="duo">
   <div class="card"><p class="lab">${h<12?'Bom dia':h<18?'Boa tarde':'Boa noite'} · ${WD[dt.getDay()]}, ${dt.getDate()} de ${MONTHS[dt.getMonth()].toLowerCase()}</p><h3 class="mb">Agenda de hoje</h3>
    ${hoje.length?lst(hoje.slice(0,4).map(apptRow).join('')).replace('class="list"','class="list" style="grid-template-columns:1fr"'):empty('Nenhuma consulta hoje.')}
    <div class="row mt"><button class="btn" onclick="nav('agenda')">Abrir agenda</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="apptForm()">+ Agendar</button></div></div>
   <div class="tile" onclick="nav('ret')">${photoTag('estetica.jpg','60% 40%')}<div class="in"><div class="sp"><span class="pilltag">${al.length} para contatar</span><b style="margin-top:8px">Cada retorno no tempo certo</b></div><button class="rb" aria-label="Abrir retornos">${ic('arrow',18)}</button></div></div>
   <div class="tile" onclick="nav('stock')">${photoTag('procedimento.jpg','40% 30%')}<div class="in"><div class="sp"><span class="pilltag">${sa.length?sa.length+' alerta(s)':'Em dia'}</span><b style="margin-top:8px">Lotes rastreados</b></div><button class="rb" aria-label="Abrir estoque">${ic('arrow',18)}</button></div></div></div>
  <div class="sec" style="margin-top:34px"><div><p class="lab">Resumo do mês</p><h2 class="h2" style="margin:0">Sua clínica em números.</h2></div></div>
  <div class="grid4">
   <div class="card dark stat"><span>Consultas hoje</span><b>${hoje.length}</b><small>${hoje.length?'Próxima: '+esc(hoje[0].time||''):'Agenda livre'}</small></div>
   <div class="card sand stat"><span>Retornos para contatar</span><b>${al.length}</b><small>${prox7} nos próximos 7 dias</small></div>
   <div class="card stat"><span>Recebido no mês</span><b class="pos">${money(fat)}</b><small>Despesas ${money(desp)} · A receber ${money(sum(rec))}</small></div>
   <div class="card stat"><span>Alertas de estoque</span><b class="${sa.length?'neg':''}">${sa.length}</b><small>${sa.length?'Validade ou estoque mínimo':'Tudo em dia'}</small></div></div>
  <div class="cols">
   <div class="card"><div class="row mb"><h3 class="sp">Retornos para contatar</h3><button class="btn ghost sm" onclick="nav('ret')">Ver todos</button></div>${al.length?lst(al.slice(0,5).map(retRow).join('')):empty('Nenhum retorno pendente hoje.')}</div>
   ${sa.length?`<div class="card"><div class="row mb"><h3 class="sp">Estoque e validade</h3><button class="btn ghost sm" onclick="nav('stock')">Abrir</button></div>${lst(sa.slice(0,4).map(x=>item({av:ic('box',18),t:esc(x.s.name),s:'Lote '+esc(x.s.lote||'—')+' · '+x.s.qty+' '+esc(x.s.unit||''),r:x.f.map(f=>`<span class="tag red">${f}</span>`).join(''),click:`stockForm('${x.s.id}')`})).join(''))}</div>`:''}
   ${bd.length?`<div class="card"><h3 class="mb">Aniversariantes de ${MONTHS[+m.slice(5,7)-1].toLowerCase()}</h3>${lst(bd.slice(0,5).map(p=>item({av:p.birth.slice(8,10),t:esc(p.name),s:esc(p.phone||''),click:`openPatient('${p.id}')`})).join(''))}</div>`:''}</div>`;
}

/* ================= pacientes ================= */
function scrPatients(){return head('Pacientes',null,`<button class="btn" onclick="patientForm()">${ic('plus',16)} Novo paciente</button>`)+`<div class="search">${ic('search',18)}<input placeholder="Buscar por nome ou telefone" value="${esc(V.q)}" oninput="V.q=this.value;$('#plist').innerHTML=patientList()"></div><div id="plist" class="list">${patientList()}</div>`;}
function patientList(){
  const q=V.q.trim().toLowerCase(),qd=digits(q);
  const l=S.patients.filter(p=>!q||p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)||(qd&&digits(p.phone).includes(qd))).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'pt-BR'));
  if(!l.length)return empty(S.patients.length?'Nenhum paciente encontrado.':'Nenhum paciente ainda. Toque em “Novo paciente”.');
  return l.map(p=>{const n=rOpen().filter(r=>r.patient_id===p.id).length,rk=riskList(p).length;return item({av:avIn(p),t:esc(p.name),s:esc(p.phone||'Sem telefone'),r:(rk?`<span class="tag red">Alerta</span>`:'')+(n?`<span class="tag">${n} retorno${n>1?'s':''}</span>`:''),click:`openPatient('${p.id}')`});}).join('');
}
function openPatient(id){nav('patient',{pid:id,ptab:'dados',sel:[]});}
function patientForm(id){
  const p=pat(id)||{an:{}},pid=id||uid();V.av=null;
  modal(`<h2>${id?'Editar paciente':'Novo paciente'}</h2>
  <div class="row mt"><div class="av lg" id="avprev" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="$('#avfile').click()">${avIn(p)}</div><div class="muted" style="font-size:13px">Toque no círculo para escolher a foto do paciente.</div></div>
  <input id="avfile" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden onchange="onAvatar(this)">
  <label class="f">Nome completo</label><input id="f_name" value="${esc(p.name)}" autocomplete="off">
  <div class="grid2"><div><label class="f">Telefone / WhatsApp</label><input id="f_phone" inputmode="tel" value="${esc(p.phone)}"></div><div><label class="f">Nascimento</label><input id="f_birth" type="date" value="${esc(p.birth)}"></div></div>
  <div class="grid2"><div><label class="f">E-mail</label><input id="f_email" type="email" value="${esc(p.email)}"></div><div><label class="f">CPF</label><input id="f_cpf" inputmode="numeric" value="${esc(p.cpf)}"></div></div>
  <label class="f">Como conheceu a clínica</label><input id="f_origem" value="${esc(p.origem)}">
  <label class="f">Anamnese: marque o que se aplica</label>${AN.map(([k,l])=>`<label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="an_${k}" ${p.an&&p.an[k]?'checked':''}> ${l}</label>`).join('')}
  <label class="f">Alergias, medicamentos e observações</label><textarea id="f_notes" rows="3">${esc(p.notes)}</textarea>
  <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="f_termo" ${p.termo?'checked':''}> Termo de consentimento assinado</label>
  <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="f_img" ${p.img?'checked':''}> Autoriza uso de imagem (fotos de antes e depois)</label>
  <div class="actions"><button class="btn line" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn" onclick="savePatient('${id||''}','${pid}')">Salvar paciente</button></div>`);
}
async function onAvatar(inp){const f=inp.files[0];if(!f)return;try{V.av=await compress(f,480,.82);$('#avprev').innerHTML=`<img src="${URL.createObjectURL(V.av)}" alt="">`;}catch(e){toast(e.message,true);}}
async function savePatient(id,pid){
  const name=val('name').trim();if(!name)return toast('Informe o nome.',true);
  const old=pat(id)||{},an={};AN.forEach(([k])=>{an[k]=$('#an_'+k).checked;});
  let avatar=old.avatar||null;
  if(V.av){const nid=uid();await imgPut(nid,V.av);if(avatar)imgDel(avatar);avatar=nid;V.av=null;}
  const r=up('patients',{...old,id:pid,name,phone:val('phone'),birth:val('birth'),email:val('email'),cpf:val('cpf'),origem:val('origem'),notes:val('notes'),an,termo:$('#f_termo').checked,img:$('#f_img').checked,avatar,odonto:old.odonto||{}});
  closeModal();toast('Paciente salvo.');if(id)render();else openPatient(r.id);
}
function scrPatient(){
  const p=pat(V.pid);if(!p){V.screen='patients';return scrPatients();}
  const tabs=[['dados','Dados'],['pront','Prontuário'],['sessoes','Sessões'],['odonto','Odontograma'],['plano','Plano de tratamento'],['orc','Orçamentos'],['fin','Financeiro'],['anexos','Anexos'],['ret','Retornos']],rk=riskList(p);
  const body={dados:tabDados,pront:tabPront,sessoes:tabSessoes,odonto:tabOdonto,plano:tabPlano,orc:tabOrc,fin:tabFin,anexos:tabAnexos,ret:tabRetP}[V.ptab](p);
  return `<div class="head"><button class="icon" onclick="nav('patients')" aria-label="Voltar">${ic('back',22)}</button><div class="av lg">${avIn(p)}</div><div class="sp"><h1 class="sm">${esc(p.name)}</h1><div class="muted">${esc(p.phone||'Sem telefone')}</div></div><button class="icon" onclick="patientForm('${p.id}')" aria-label="Editar">${ic('edit',20)}</button></div>
  ${rk.length?`<div class="banner red">Alertas de anamnese: ${esc(rk.join(' · '))}</div>`:''}
  <div class="chips">${tabs.map(([k,l])=>`<button class="chip ${V.ptab===k?'on':''}" onclick="V.ptab='${k}';render()">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>${body}`;
}
function tabDados(p){
  const age=p.birth?Math.floor((Date.now()-new Date(p.birth+'T00:00:00'))/31557600000):null;
  const next=S.appts.filter(a=>a.patient_id===p.id&&a.date>=today()&&a.status!=='cancelado').sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time)).slice(0,3);
  return `<div class="cols" style="margin-top:0"><div class="card">
   <div class="kv"><span>Telefone</span><b>${p.phone?`<a href="${waLink(p.phone)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(p.phone)} · WhatsApp</a>`:'—'}</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span>Nascimento</span><b>${p.birth?fdate(p.birth)+(age!=null?' ('+age+' anos)':''):'—'}</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span>E-mail</span><b>${esc(p.email||'—')}</b></div><div class="kv"><span>CPF</span><b>${esc(p.cpf||'—')}</b></div><div class="kv"><span>Origem</span><b>${esc(p.origem||'—')}</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span>Termo de consentimento</span><b><span class="tag ${p.termo?'ok':'warn'}">${p.termo?'Assinado':'Pendente'}</span></b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span>Uso de imagem</span><b><span class="tag ${p.img?'ok':'warn'}">${p.img?'Autorizado':'Não autorizado'}</span></b></div></div>
  <div class="card"><h3>Anamnese e observações</h3><p class="pre">${esc(p.notes||'Nada registrado.')}</p></div></div>
  <div class="sec"><h3>Próximas consultas</h3></div>${next.length?lst(next.map(apptRow).join('')):empty('Sem consultas futuras.')}
  <div class="row mt wrap"><button class="btn gold" onclick="newSession('${p.id}')">Nova sessão</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="apptForm('','${p.id}')">Agendar</button><button class="btn line" onclick="printTermo('${p.id}')">Imprimir termo</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="delPatient('${p.id}')">Excluir paciente</button></div>`;
}
function delPatient(id){if(!confirm('Excluir o paciente e todo o histórico (prontuário, sessões, retornos, anexos, orçamentos e consultas)?'))return;delPatientData(id);nav('patients');toast('Paciente excluído.');}
function printTermo(pid){
  const p=pat(pid),c=CL();
  printDoc(`<h1 style="font-size:22px">${esc(c.name||'Clínica')}</h1><p>${esc([c.prof,c.reg,c.phone].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</p>
  <h2 style="margin-top:18px">Termo de consentimento livre e esclarecido</h2><p>Paciente: <b>${esc(p.name)}</b> · Data: ${fdate(today())}</p>
  <p>Declaro que recebi explicações claras sobre o procedimento estético proposto, seus objetivos, resultados esperados e limitações, alternativas, cuidados pré e pós-procedimento e possíveis riscos e intercorrências, incluindo edema, hematomas, assimetrias, reações alérgicas e outras complicações descritas pelo profissional. Informei corretamente meu histórico de saúde, alergias e medicamentos em uso, e tive a oportunidade de esclarecer minhas dúvidas.</p>
  <p>Autorizo o registro fotográfico para acompanhamento do tratamento: (&nbsp;&nbsp;) sim &nbsp;&nbsp; (&nbsp;&nbsp;) não. Autorizo o uso das imagens em divulgação: (&nbsp;&nbsp;) sim &nbsp;&nbsp; (&nbsp;&nbsp;) não.</p>
  <p>Estou ciente de que o resultado varia de pessoa para pessoa e de que não há garantia de resultado.</p>
  <div class="sign"><div>${esc(p.name)}</div><div>${esc(c.prof||'Profissional responsável')}${c.reg?' · '+esc(c.reg):''}</div></div>`);
}

/* ---------- prontuário (evoluções + sessões) ---------- */
function tabPront(p){
  const ev=S.evolutions.filter(e=>e.patient_id===p.id).map(e=>({...e,k:'evo'})),ss=S.sessions.filter(s=>s.patient_id===p.id).map(s=>({...s,k:'ses'}));
  const l=[...ev,...ss].sort((a,b)=>(b.date||'').localeCompare(a.date||'')||(b.created_at||'').localeCompare(a.created_at||''));
  return `<div class="row mb wrap"><button class="btn" onclick="evoForm('','${p.id}')">${ic('plus',16)} Nova evolução</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="printPront('${p.id}')">Imprimir prontuário</button></div>
  ${p.notes?`<div class="card mb"><h3>Anamnese e observações</h3><p class="pre">${esc(p.notes)}</p></div>`:''}
  ${l.length?`<div class="evo-list">${l.map(e=>e.k==='evo'?evoCard(e):`<div class="card evo" onclick="openSession('${e.id}')"><div class="row"><b class="sp">${fdate(e.date)} · Sessão</b><span class="tag">${esc(protName(e.proc))}</span></div><p class="evo-sub">${esc(e.product||'')}${e.lote?' · lote '+esc(e.lote):''}${e.qty?' · '+e.qty+' '+esc(e.unit||''):''}</p>${e.regions?`<p class="evo-sub"><b>Regiões:</b> ${esc(e.regions)}</p>`:''}${e.notes?`<p class="evo-sub">${esc(e.notes)}</p>`:''}</div>`).join('')}</div>`:empty('Nenhum registro. Toque em “Nova evolução” a cada consulta.')}`;
}
function evoCard(e){return `<div class="card evo" onclick="evoForm('${e.id}','${e.patient_id}')"><div class="row"><b class="sp">${fdate(e.date)}${e.region?' · '+esc(e.region):''}</b>${e.proc?`<span class="tag">${esc(e.proc)}</span>`:''}</div><p class="pre">${esc(e.description||'')}</p>${e.prescription?`<p class="evo-sub"><b>Conduta / prescrição:</b> ${esc(e.prescription)}</p>`:''}${e.next?`<p class="evo-sub"><b>Retorno:</b> ${esc(e.next)}</p>`:''}<small class="muted">${esc(e.author||'')}${e.edited_at?' · editado em '+fdate(e.edited_at):''}</small></div>`;}
function evoForm(id,pid){
  const e=S.evolutions.find(x=>x.id===id)||{date:today()};
  modal(`<h2>${id?'Editar evolução':'Nova evolução'}</h2>
  <div class="grid2"><div><label class="f">Data</label><input id="f_date" type="date" value="${esc(e.date)}"></div><div><label class="f">Região / dente</label><input id="f_region" value="${esc(e.region)}" placeholder="Ex.: glabela, 11"></div></div>
  <label class="f">Procedimento</label><input id="f_proc" list="dl_p" value="${esc(e.proc)}" autocomplete="off">${procList()}
  <label class="f">Evolução / descrição do atendimento</label><textarea id="f_description" rows="5">${esc(e.description)}</textarea>
  <label class="f">Conduta, medicação ou orientações</label><textarea id="f_prescription" rows="2">${esc(e.prescription)}</textarea>
  <label class="f">Retorno / próximos passos</label><input id="f_next" value="${esc(e.next)}">
  <div class="actions">${id?`<button class="btn danger" onclick="delRec('evolutions','${id}')">Excluir</button>`:`<button class="btn line" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button>`}<button class="btn" onclick="saveEvo('${id||''}','${pid}')">Salvar evolução</button></div>`);
}
function saveEvo(id,pid){
  const description=val('description').trim();if(!description)return toast('Descreva a evolução do atendimento.',true);
  const old=S.evolutions.find(x=>x.id===id)||{},c=CL();
  up('evolutions',{...old,id:id||uid(),patient_id:pid,date:val('date')||today(),region:val('region').trim(),proc:val('proc').trim(),description,prescription:val('prescription').trim(),next:val('next').trim(),author:old.author||[c.prof,c.reg].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),edited_at:id?new Date().toISOString():null});
  closeModal();render();toast('Evolução salva.');
}
function delRec(kind,id){if(!confirm('Excluir este item?'))return;rm(kind,id);closeModal();render();toast('Excluído.');}
const procList=()=>`<datalist id="dl_p">${S.protocols.map(o=>`<option value="${esc(o.name)}">`).join('')}</datalist>`;
function printPront(pid){
  const p=pat(pid),c=CL(),ev=S.evolutions.filter(e=>e.patient_id===pid).map(e=>({d:e.date,t:`${esc(e.region||'')}${e.proc?' · '+esc(e.proc):''}`,b:esc(e.description||'').replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+(e.prescription?`<br><i>Conduta:</i> ${esc(e.prescription)}`:'')+(e.next?`<br><i>Retorno:</i> ${esc(e.next)}`:'')})),
  ss=S.sessions.filter(s=>s.patient_id===pid).map(s=>({d:s.date,t:'Sessão · '+esc(protName(s.proc)),b:`${esc(s.product||'')} ${s.lote?'· lote '+esc(s.lote):''} ${s.qty?'· '+s.qty+' '+esc(s.unit||''):''}${s.regions?'<br>Regiões: '+esc(s.regions):''}${s.notes?'<br>'+esc(s.notes):''}`})),
  l=[...ev,...ss].sort((a,b)=>(a.d||'').localeCompare(b.d||''));
  printDoc(`<h1 style="font-size:22px">${esc(c.name||'Clínica')}</h1><p>${esc([c.prof,c.reg,c.phone].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</p><h2 style="margin-top:18px">Prontuário — ${esc(p.name)}</h2><p>${p.birth?'Nascimento: '+fdate(p.birth)+' · ':''}${p.phone?'Telefone: '+esc(p.phone):''}</p>${p.notes?`<p><b>Anamnese:</b><br>${esc(p.notes).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</p>`:''}${l.map(e=>`<div style="margin:14px 0;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #999"><b>${fdate(e.d)} · ${e.t}</b><br>${e.b}</div>`).join('')}<div class="sign"><div>Paciente</div><div>${esc(c.prof||'Profissional responsável')}</div></div>`);
}

/* ---------- odontograma ---------- */
const TOOLS=[{k:'carie',l:'Cárie',c:'#ef4444',t:'face'},{k:'restauracao',l:'Restauração',c:'#3b82f6',t:'face'},{k:'faceta',l:'Faceta / lente',c:'#c9a36a',t:'face'},{k:'fratura',l:'Fratura',c:'#f59e0b',t:'face'},{k:'clareamento',l:'Clareamento',c:'#e8d98a',t:'face'},{k:'canal',l:'Endodontia',c:'#7c3aed',t:'whole'},{k:'coroa',l:'Coroa',c:'#d97706',t:'whole'},{k:'implante',l:'Implante',c:'#475569',t:'whole'},{k:'ext_ind',l:'Extração indicada',c:'#dc2626',t:'whole'},{k:'ausente',l:'Ausente',c:'#94a3b8',t:'whole'},{k:'limpar',l:'Borracha',c:'#5b3a28',t:'clear'}];
const rng=(a,b)=>Array.from({length:Math.abs(b-a)+1},(_,i)=>a<=b?a+i:a-i);
const QUADS=[{k:1,ids:rng(18,11),t:'Superior direito'},{k:2,ids:rng(21,28),t:'Superior esquerdo'},{k:4,ids:rng(48,41),t:'Inferior direito'},{k:3,ids:rng(31,38),t:'Inferior esquerdo'}];
const QDEC=[{k:5,ids:rng(55,51),t:'Superior direito'},{k:6,ids:rng(61,65),t:'Superior esquerdo'},{k:8,ids:rng(85,81),t:'Inferior direito'},{k:7,ids:rng(71,75),t:'Inferior esquerdo'}];
const toolName=k=>(TOOLS.find(t=>t.k===k)||{}).l||k,toolColor=k=>(TOOLS.find(t=>t.k===k)||{}).c||'#999';
function tabOdonto(p){
  return `<div class="chips tools">${TOOLS.map(t=>`<button class="chip ${V.otool===t.k?'on':''}" data-k="${t.k}" onclick="setTool('${t.k}')"><i style="background:${t.c}"></i>${t.l}</button>`).join('')}</div>
  <div class="seg mb"><button class="${!V.dec?'on':''}" onclick="V.dec=false;render()">Dentes permanentes</button><button class="${V.dec?'on':''}" onclick="V.dec=true;render()">Dentes decíduos</button></div>
  <div class="card"><div id="odonto">${odontoGrid(p)}</div></div>
  <p class="hint">Escolha uma marcação e toque nas faces do dente (V vestibular, L lingual/palatina, M mesial, D distal, O oclusal/incisal). Toque no número para ver os achados e adicionar ao plano. Salva automaticamente.</p><div id="odosum">${odontoSummary(p)}</div>`;
}
function setTool(k){V.otool=k;document.querySelectorAll('.tools .chip').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',b.dataset.k===k));}
function odontoGrid(p){const O=p.odonto||{};return `<div class="odo">${(V.dec?QDEC:QUADS).map(q=>`<div class="quad"><div class="quad-t">${q.t}</div><div class="teeth ${[1,4,5,8].includes(q.k)?'r':'l'}">${q.ids.map(n=>toothSvg(n,O[n])).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function toothSvg(n,d){
  d=d||{};const f=d.faces||{},w=d.whole,q=Math.floor(n/10),upper=[1,2,5,6].includes(q),pr=[1,4,5,8].includes(q);
  const top=upper?'V':'L',bot=upper?'L':'V',lef=pr?'D':'M',rig=pr?'M':'D';
  const shapes=[[top,'1,1 39,1 29,11 11,11'],[bot,'1,39 39,39 29,29 11,29'],[lef,'1,1 11,11 11,29 1,39'],[rig,'39,1 29,11 29,29 39,39']];
  const fl=fc=>f[fc]?toolColor(f[fc]):'var(--tooth)';
  let s=shapes.map(([fc,pts])=>`<polygon points="${pts}" fill="${fl(fc)}" stroke="var(--tl)" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linejoin="round" onclick="paint(${n},'${fc}')"/>`).join('');
  s+=`<rect x="11" y="11" width="18" height="18" fill="${fl('O')}" stroke="var(--tl)" stroke-width="1.2" onclick="paint(${n},'O')"/>`;
  s=`<g${w==='ausente'?' opacity=".4"':''}>${s}</g>`;
  const ov={canal:'<path d="M20 6V34" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',coroa:'<rect x="2" y="2" width="36" height="36" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="3.5"/>',implante:'<circle cx="20" cy="20" r="12" fill="#475569" opacity=".92"/><text x="20" y="23.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-weight="800" fill="#fff" font-family="sans-serif">IMP</text>',ext_ind:'<path d="M4 4L36 36M36 4L4 36" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>',ausente:'<path d="M4 4L36 36M36 4L4 36" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>'}[w]||'';
  return `<div class="tooth"><svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" role="img" aria-label="Dente ${n}">${s}<g pointer-events="none">${ov}</g></svg><button class="n" onclick="toothModal(${n})">${n}</button></div>`;
}
function paint(n,face){
  const p=pat(V.pid);if(!p)return;const O=p.odonto=p.odonto||{},d=O[n]=O[n]||{faces:{}};d.faces=d.faces||{};const t=TOOLS.find(x=>x.k===V.otool);
  if(t.t==='face'){if(d.faces[face]===t.k)delete d.faces[face];else d.faces[face]=t.k;}
  else if(t.t==='whole'){d.whole=d.whole===t.k?null:t.k;}
  else{if(d.faces[face])delete d.faces[face];else d.whole=null;}
  if(!d.whole&&!Object.keys(d.faces).length)delete O[n];
  $('#odonto').innerHTML=odontoGrid(p);$('#odosum').innerHTML=odontoSummary(p);
  clearTimeout(V.st);V.st=setTimeout(()=>{up('patients',{id:p.id,odonto:p.odonto});toast('Odontograma salvo.');},700);
}
function findText(d){const parts=[];if(d.whole)parts.push(toolName(d.whole));const by={};Object.entries(d.faces||{}).forEach(([fc,c])=>{(by[c]=by[c]||[]).push(fc);});Object.entries(by).forEach(([c,fs])=>parts.push(toolName(c)+' ('+fs.join('')+')'));return parts.join(', ');}
function odontoSummary(p){const O=p.odonto||{},ks=Object.keys(O).sort((a,b)=>a-b);if(!ks.length)return '';return `<div class="card mt"><h3>Achados</h3><div class="finds">${ks.map(n=>`<button class="find" onclick="toothModal(${n})"><b>${n}</b> ${esc(findText(O[n]))}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;}
function toothModal(n){
  const p=pat(V.pid),d=(p.odonto||{})[n],inPlan=S.plans.filter(x=>x.patient_id===p.id&&String(x.tooth)===String(n));
  modal(`<h2>Dente ${n}</h2><p class="muted">${d?esc(findText(d)):'Sem achados registrados.'}</p>${inPlan.length?`<h3 class="mt">No plano de tratamento</h3>${inPlan.map(x=>`<div class="kv"><span>${esc(x.proc)}</span><b>${money(x.value)}</b></div>`).join('')}`:''}
  <div class="actions"><button class="btn danger" onclick="clearTooth(${n})">Limpar dente</button><button class="btn" onclick="planForm('','${p.id}',${n})">Adicionar ao plano</button></div>`);
}
function clearTooth(n){const p=pat(V.pid);if(p&&p.odonto){delete p.odonto[n];up('patients',{id:p.id,odonto:p.odonto});}closeModal();render();}

/* ---------- plano de tratamento ---------- */
function tabPlano(p){
  const l=S.plans.filter(x=>x.patient_id===p.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.created_at||'').localeCompare(b.created_at||''));
  return `<div class="grid4"><div class="card stat"><span>Total do plano</span><b>${money(sum(l))}</b></div><div class="card sand stat"><span>Concluído</span><b class="pos">${money(sum(l.filter(x=>x.status==='concluido')))}</b></div></div>
  <div class="row mt mb wrap"><button class="btn" onclick="planForm('','${p.id}')">${ic('plus',16)} Procedimento</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="budgetFromPlan('${p.id}')">Gerar orçamento</button></div>
  ${l.length?lst(l.map(x=>{const s=PST[x.status]||PST.planejado;return item({av:esc(x.tooth||'—'),t:esc(x.proc),s:money(x.value),r:`<span class="tag ${s[1]}">${s[0]}</span>`,click:`planForm('${x.id}','${p.id}')`});}).join('')):empty('Nenhum procedimento planejado. Adicione aqui ou toque em um dente no odontograma.')}`;
}
function planForm(id,pid,tooth){
  const x=S.plans.find(y=>y.id===id)||{tooth:tooth||'',status:'planejado'};
  modal(`<h2>${id?'Editar procedimento':'Novo procedimento'}</h2>
  <div class="grid2"><div><label class="f">Dente / região</label><input id="f_tooth" value="${esc(x.tooth)}" placeholder="Ex.: 16 ou glabela"></div><div><label class="f">Valor (R$)</label><input id="f_value" type="number" step="0.01" inputmode="decimal" value="${x.value==null?'':x.value}"></div></div>
  <label class="f">Procedimento</label><input id="f_proc" list="dl_p" value="${esc(x.proc)}" oninput="autoVal()" autocomplete="off">${procList()}
  <label class="f">Situação</label><select id="f_status">${opts(Object.entries(PST).map(([k,v])=>[k,v[0]]),x.status)}</select>
  <div class="actions">${id?`<button class="btn danger" onclick="delRec('plans','${id}')">Excluir</button>`:`<button class="btn line" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button>`}<button class="btn" onclick="savePlan('${id||''}','${pid}')">Salvar</button></div>`);
}
function autoVal(){const o=S.protocols.find(p=>p.name===val('proc')),el=$('#f_value');if(o&&o.price&&(!el.value||el.value===el.dataset.auto)){el.value=o.price;el.dataset.auto=String(o.price);}}
function savePlan(id,pid){const proc=val('proc').trim();if(!proc)return toast('Informe o procedimento.',true);const old=S.plans.find(x=>x.id===id)||{};up('plans',{...old,id:id||uid(),patient_id:pid,tooth:val('tooth').trim(),proc,value:num('value'),status:val('status')});closeModal();render();toast('Plano atualizado.');}
function budgetFromPlan(pid){const items=S.plans.filter(x=>x.patient_id===pid&&x.status!=='concluido').map(x=>({description:x.proc,tooth:x.tooth||'',qty:1,value:+x.value||0}));if(!items.length)return toast('Não há procedimentos pendentes no plano.',true);newBudget(pid,items,'patient');}

/* ---------- orçamentos ---------- */
function bTot(b){const sub=(b.items||[]).reduce((s,i)=>s+(+i.qty||1)*(+i.value||0),0),disc=sub*(+b.discount||0)/100,total=Math.max(0,sub-disc),entrada=Math.min(+b.entrada||0,total),n=Math.max(1,parseInt(b.installments)||1),rest=total-entrada;return {sub,disc,total,entrada,n,rest,parc:rest/n};}
function budgetRow(b){const s=BST[b.status]||BST.pendente;return item({av:'#'+(b.num||'?'),t:esc(pname(b.patient_id)),s:fdate(b.created_at)+' · '+(b.items||[]).length+' itens',r:`${money(bTot(b).total)}<span class="tag ${s[1]}">${s[0]}</span>`,click:`openBudget('${b.id}','${V.screen==='patient'?'patient':'list'}')`});}
function scrBudgets(){
  const fl=[['todos','Todos'],['pendente','Pendentes'],['aprovado','Aprovados'],['recusado','Recusados']],l=S.budgets.filter(b=>V.bfilter==='todos'||b.status===V.bfilter).sort((a,b)=>(b.created_at||'').localeCompare(a.created_at||''));
  return head('Orçamentos',"nav('more')",`<button class="btn" onclick="newBudget()">${ic('plus',16)} Novo orçamento</button>`)+`<div class="chips">${fl.map(([k,t])=>`<button class="chip ${V.bfilter===k?'on':''}" onclick="V.bfilter='${k}';render()">${t}</button>`).join('')}</div>`+(l.length?lst(l.map(budgetRow).join('')):empty('Nenhum orçamento. Gere um a partir do plano de tratamento de um paciente.'));
}
function tabOrc(p){const l=S.budgets.filter(b=>b.patient_id===p.id).sort((a,b)=>(b.created_at||'').localeCompare(a.created_at||''));return `<button class="btn mb" onclick="newBudget('${p.id}',null,'patient')">${ic('plus',16)} Novo orçamento</button>`+(l.length?lst(l.map(budgetRow).join('')):empty('Nenhum orçamento para este paciente.'));}
function newBudget(pid,items,from){if(!S.patients.length)return toast('Cadastre um paciente primeiro.',true);const num=Math.max(0,...S.budgets.map(b=>b.num||0))+1;V.bud={id:uid(),patient_id:pid||'',num,items:items||[],discount:0,entrada:0,installments:1,first_due:today(),status:'pendente',generated:false,notes:'',isNew:true};V.from=from||'list';nav('budget');}
function openBudget(id,from){const b=S.budgets.find(x=>x.id===id);V.bud=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(b));V.from=from||'list';if(from==='patient')V.pid=b.patient_id;nav('budget');}
function backBudget(){if(V.from==='patient'&&V.bud.patient_id)nav('patient',{pid:V.bud.patient_id,ptab:'orc'});else nav('budgets');}
function scrBudget(){
  const b=V.bud;
  return `<div class="narrow"><div class="head"><button class="icon" onclick="backBudget()" aria-label="Voltar">${ic('back',22)}</button><h1 class="sp">Orçamento #${b.num}</h1>${b.isNew?'':`<button class="icon" onclick="delBudget()" aria-label="Excluir">${ic('trash',20)}</button>`}</div>
  <div class="card"><label class="f" style="margin-top:0">Paciente</label><select onchange="V.bud.patient_id=this.value">${opts([['','Selecione…'],...[...S.patients].sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'pt-BR')).map(p=>[p.id,p.name])],b.patient_id)}</select></div>
  <div class="sec"><h3>Procedimentos</h3></div><div id="bitems">${budgetItems()}</div>
  <div class="row mt"><button class="btn ghost sp" onclick="pickProc()">+ Da tabela</button><button class="btn ghost sp" onclick="addBItem()">+ Item livre</button></div>
  <div class="card mt"><div class="grid2"><div><label class="f" style="margin-top:0">Desconto (%)</label><input type="number" step="0.5" min="0" value="${b.discount||0}" oninput="setB('discount',parseFloat(this.value)||0)"></div><div><label class="f" style="margin-top:0">Entrada (R$)</label><input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value="${b.entrada||0}" oninput="setB('entrada',parseFloat(this.value)||0)"></div></div>
  <div class="grid2"><div><label class="f">Nº de parcelas</label><input type="number" min="1" max="60" value="${b.installments||1}" oninput="setB('installments',parseInt(this.value)||1)"></div><div><label class="f">1º vencimento</label><input type="date" value="${esc(b.first_due||today())}" onchange="V.bud.first_due=this.value"></div></div><div id="btot" class="tot">${budgetTotals()}</div></div>
  <label class="f">Observações</label><textarea rows="2" oninput="V.bud.notes=this.value">${esc(b.notes||'')}</textarea>
  <label class="f">Situação</label><div class="seg">${Object.entries(BST).map(([k,v])=>`<button class="${b.status===k?'on':''}" onclick="V.bud.status='${k}';render()">${v[0]}</button>`).join('')}</div>
  ${b.generated?`<p class="hint">As parcelas deste orçamento já foram lançadas no financeiro.</p>`:b.status==='aprovado'?`<p class="hint">Ao salvar como aprovado, você poderá lançar a entrada e as parcelas no financeiro.</p>`:''}
  <div class="actions"><button class="btn line" onclick="shareBudget()">${ic('send',16)} WhatsApp</button><button class="btn line" onclick="printBudget()">Imprimir / PDF</button></div>
  <button class="btn gold block mt" onclick="saveBudget()">Salvar orçamento</button></div>`;
}
function budgetItems(){const it=V.bud.items;if(!it.length)return empty('Nenhum item ainda.');return it.map((i,k)=>`<div class="bi"><div class="row"><input placeholder="Procedimento" value="${esc(i.description)}" oninput="setBItem(${k},'description',this.value)"><button class="icon" onclick="rmBItem(${k})" aria-label="Remover">${ic('trash',18)}</button></div><div class="g"><div><small>Dente / região</small><input value="${esc(i.tooth)}" oninput="setBItem(${k},'tooth',this.value)"></div><div><small>Qtd.</small><input type="number" min="1" value="${i.qty||1}" oninput="setBItem(${k},'qty',parseInt(this.value)||1)"></div><div><small>Valor unitário (R$)</small><input type="number" step="0.01" value="${i.value||0}" oninput="setBItem(${k},'value',parseFloat(this.value)||0)"></div></div></div>`).join('');}
function budgetTotals(){const t=bTot(V.bud);return `<div class="kv"><span>Subtotal</span><b>${money(t.sub)}</b></div>${t.disc?`<div class="kv"><span>Desconto</span><b>− ${money(t.disc)}</b></div>`:''}<div class="kv"><span>Total</span><b class="big">${money(t.total)}</b></div><div class="kv"><span>Condição</span><b>${t.entrada?'Entrada de '+money(t.entrada)+' + ':''}${t.n}× de ${money(t.parc)}</b></div>`;}
function setB(k,v){V.bud[k]=v;$('#btot').innerHTML=budgetTotals();}
function setBItem(i,k,v){V.bud.items[i][k]=v;$('#btot').innerHTML=budgetTotals();}
function rmBItem(i){V.bud.items.splice(i,1);$('#bitems').innerHTML=budgetItems();$('#btot').innerHTML=budgetTotals();}
function pickProc(){const l=S.protocols.filter(p=>p.key!=='outro');modal(`<h2>Tabela de procedimentos</h2><p class="muted">Toque para adicionar ao orçamento.</p><div class="mt">${l.map(o=>`<div style="margin-bottom:8px">${item({av:ic('spark',18),t:esc(o.name),r:money(o.price),click:`addBItem('${o.key}')`})}</div>`).join('')}</div>`);}
function addBItem(key){const o=S.protocols.find(x=>x.key===key);V.bud.items.push({description:o?o.name:'',tooth:'',qty:1,value:o?+o.price||0:0});closeModal();$('#bitems').innerHTML=budgetItems();$('#btot').innerHTML=budgetTotals();}
function saveBudget(){
  const b=V.bud;if(!b.patient_id)return toast('Selecione o paciente.',true);
  const items=b.items.filter(i=>i.description&&i.description.trim());if(!items.length)return toast('Adicione pelo menos um procedimento.',true);
  const {isNew,...row}=b;row.items=items;
  const gen=row.status==='aprovado'&&!row.generated&&bTot(row).total>0&&confirm('Lançar a entrada e as parcelas no financeiro como valores a receber?');
  if(gen)row.generated=true;up('budgets',row);if(gen)genInstallments(row);
  toast(gen?'Orçamento salvo e parcelas lançadas.':'Orçamento salvo.');V.bud={...row};backBudget();
}
function genInstallments(b){
  const t=bTot(b),n=t.n,due=b.first_due||today(),desc='Orçamento #'+b.num,rows=[];
  if(t.entrada>0)rows.push({description:desc+' – entrada',value:+t.entrada.toFixed(2),date:due});
  const rest=+(t.total-t.entrada).toFixed(2),base=Math.floor(rest/n*100)/100;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const v=i===n-1?+(rest-base*(n-1)).toFixed(2):base;if(v>0)rows.push({description:`${desc} – parcela ${i+1}/${n}`,value:v,date:addMonths(due,i+(t.entrada>0?1:0))});}
  rows.forEach(r=>up('tx',{id:uid(),type:'entrada',category:'Procedimento',status:'pendente',method:'',patient_id:b.patient_id,budget_id:b.id,...r}));
}
function delBudget(){if(!confirm('Excluir este orçamento? Lançamentos já feitos no financeiro serão mantidos.'))return;rm('budgets',V.bud.id);toast('Orçamento excluído.');backBudget();}
function budgetText(){const b=V.bud,p=pat(b.patient_id)||{},t=bTot(b);return `*${CL().name||'Orçamento'} – Orçamento #${b.num}*\nPaciente: ${p.name||''}\n\n`+b.items.filter(i=>i.description).map(i=>`• ${i.description}${i.tooth?' ('+i.tooth+')':''}${(+i.qty||1)>1?' x'+i.qty:''} – ${money((+i.qty||1)*(+i.value||0))}`).join('\n')+`\n\n${t.disc?'Desconto: '+money(t.disc)+'\n':''}*Total: ${money(t.total)}*\nCondição: ${t.entrada?'entrada de '+money(t.entrada)+' + ':''}${t.n}× de ${money(t.parc)}`;}
function shareBudget(){if(!V.bud.patient_id||!V.bud.items.length)return toast('Preencha o paciente e os procedimentos primeiro.',true);window.open(waLink((pat(V.bud.patient_id)||{}).phone,budgetText()),'_blank');}
function printBudget(){
  const b=V.bud;if(!b.patient_id||!b.items.length)return toast('Preencha o paciente e os procedimentos primeiro.',true);const p=pat(b.patient_id)||{},t=bTot(b),c=CL();
  printDoc(`<h1 style="font-size:22px">${esc(c.name||'Clínica')}</h1><p>${esc([c.prof,c.reg,c.phone].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</p><h2 style="margin-top:18px">Orçamento #${b.num}</h2><p>Paciente: <b>${esc(p.name||'')}</b> · Data: ${fdate(b.created_at||today())}</p>
  <table><thead><tr><th>Procedimento</th><th>Região</th><th class="r">Qtd.</th><th class="r">Unitário</th><th class="r">Total</th></tr></thead><tbody>${b.items.filter(i=>i.description).map(i=>`<tr><td>${esc(i.description)}</td><td>${esc(i.tooth||'')}</td><td class="r">${+i.qty||1}</td><td class="r">${money(i.value)}</td><td class="r">${money((+i.qty||1)*(+i.value||0))}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>
  <p class="r">Subtotal: ${money(t.sub)}${t.disc?` · Desconto: ${money(t.disc)}`:''}<br><b style="font-size:17px">Total: ${money(t.total)}</b></p><p>Condição: ${t.entrada?'entrada de '+money(t.entrada)+' + ':''}${t.n}× de ${money(t.parc)}</p>${b.notes?`<p>Observações: ${esc(b.notes)}</p>`:''}<div class="sign"><div>Paciente</div><div>${esc(c.prof||'Profissional responsável')}</div></div>`);
}

/* ---------- financeiro do paciente ---------- */
function tabFin(p){
  const l=S.tx.filter(x=>x.patient_id===p.id).sort((a,b)=>(b.date||'').localeCompare(a.date||''));
  const pago=sum(l.filter(x=>x.type==='entrada'&&x.status==='pago')),pend=sum(l.filter(x=>x.type==='entrada'&&x.status==='pendente'));
  return `<div class="grid4"><div class="card sand stat"><span>Pago</span><b class="pos">${money(pago)}</b></div><div class="card stat"><span>Em aberto</span><b class="${pend?'neg':''}">${money(pend)}</b></div></div>
  <button class="btn gold mt mb" onclick="txForm('','entrada','${p.id}')">${ic('plus',16)} Lançar recebimento</button>${l.length?lst(l.map(txRow).join('')):empty('Nenhum lançamento para este paciente.')}`;
}

/* ---------- anexos ---------- */
function tabAnexos(p){
  const l=S.photos.filter(x=>x.patient_id===p.id).sort((a,b)=>(b.date||'').localeCompare(a.date||'')||(b.created_at||'').localeCompare(a.created_at||''));
  return `<p class="hint" style="margin-top:0">Fotos do paciente, antes e depois, radiografias e a ficha clínica de papel fotografada com o celular. As imagens são comprimidas antes de salvar. Marque duas fotos para comparar.</p>
  <div class="att-kinds">${ATT.map(([k,t,i])=>`<button onclick="pickAtt('${k}')">${ic(i,20)}${t}</button>`).join('')}</div>
  <div class="row mb"><button class="btn ghost" ${V.sel.length===2?'':'disabled'} onclick="compareModal()">Comparar fotos (${V.sel.length}/2)</button></div>
  <input id="phfile" type="file" accept="image/*" multiple hidden onchange="onPhotos('${p.id}',this)">
  ${l.length?`<div class="att-grid">${l.map(x=>`<div class="att-card" onclick="photoView('${x.id}')"><div class="th"><img data-img="${x.id}" alt=""></div><input type="checkbox" ${V.sel.includes(x.id)?'checked':''} onclick="event.stopPropagation();selPhoto('${x.id}')"><div class="cap"><b>${esc(attLabel(x.kind))}</b><small>${fdate(x.date)}</small></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`:empty('Nenhum anexo ainda. Toque em um dos tipos acima para enviar uma foto.')}`;
}
function pickAtt(k){V.pkind=k;$('#phfile').click();}
async function onPhotos(pid,inp){
  const fs=[...inp.files];inp.value='';if(!fs.length)return;toast('Enviando…');
  for(const f of fs){try{const b=await compress(f,1600,.75),id=uid();await imgPut(id,b);up('photos',{id,patient_id:pid,kind:V.pkind,name:f.name,date:today()});}catch(e){toast('Falha em '+f.name+': '+e.message,true);}}
  render();toast('Anexos salvos.');
}
function selPhoto(id){const i=V.sel.indexOf(id);if(i>=0)V.sel.splice(i,1);else{if(V.sel.length>=2)V.sel.shift();V.sel.push(id);}render();}
function photoView(id){const x=S.photos.find(y=>y.id===id);modal(`<h2>${esc(attLabel(x.kind))}</h2><p class="muted" style="margin:0">${esc(x.name||'')} · ${fdate(x.date)}</p><img data-img="${id}" alt="" style="max-width:100%;max-height:66vh;border-radius:14px;display:block;margin:10px auto"><div class="actions"><button class="btn line" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="delPhoto('${id}')">Excluir</button></div>`);}
function delPhoto(id){if(!confirm('Excluir este anexo?'))return;imgDel(id);rm('photos',id);V.sel=V.sel.filter(x=>x!==id);closeModal();render();}
function compareModal(){
  const [a,b]=V.sel,A=S.photos.find(x=>x.id===a),B=S.photos.find(x=>x.id===b);
  modal(`<h2>Comparar fotos</h2><div class="cmp mt"><img data-img="${b}" alt=""><img id="cmpA" data-img="${a}" alt="" style="clip-path:inset(0 50% 0 0)"><span class="lb" style="left:10px">${esc(attLabel(A.kind))} · ${fdate(A.date)}</span><span class="lb" style="right:10px">${esc(attLabel(B.kind))} · ${fdate(B.date)}</span></div><input class="cmp-r" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" oninput="$('#cmpA').style.clipPath='inset(0 '+(100-this.value)+'% 0 0)'" aria-label="Deslizar comparação"><div class="actions"><button class="btn line" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div>`);
}

/* ---------- sessões ---------- */
function tabSessoes(p){
  const l=S.sessions.filter(s=>s.patient_id===p.id).sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
  return `<button class="btn gold mb" onclick="newSession('${p.id}')">${ic('plus',16)} Nova sessão</button>`+(l.length?lst(l.map(s=>item({av:ic('spark',18),t:esc(protName(s.proc)),s:fdate(s.date)+(s.product?' · '+esc(s.product):'')+(s.lote?' · lote '+esc(s.lote):''),r:s.value?money(s.value):'',click:`openSession('${s.id}')`})).join('')):empty('Nenhuma sessão registrada.'));
}
function newSession(pid){
  if(!S.patients.length)return toast('Cadastre um paciente primeiro.',true);const k=S.protocols[0].key;
  V.ses={id:uid(),isNew:true,patient_id:pid||'',date:today(),proc:k,stock_id:'',product:'',lote:'',validade:'',qty:'',points:[],regions:'',value:S.protocols[0].price||'',pay:'pago',method:'Pix',notes:'',pos:S.protocols[0].pos||''};
  V.ptool=P2T[k]||'outro';V.from=pid?'patient':'list';if(pid)V.pid=pid;nav('session');
}
function openSession(id){const s=S.sessions.find(x=>x.id===id);V.ses=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s));V.ses.qtyMan=true;V.ses.points=V.ses.points||[];V.pid=s.patient_id;V.from='patient';V.ptool=P2T[s.proc]||'outro';nav('session');}
function backSes(){V.ses=null;if(V.pid&&pat(V.pid)&&V.from==='patient')nav('patient',{pid:V.pid,ptab:'sessoes'});else nav('patients');}
function setProc(k){const pr=protOf(k);V.ses.proc=k;V.ses.pos=pr.pos||'';if(V.ses.isNew&&pr.price)V.ses.value=pr.price;V.ptool=P2T[k]||'outro';render();}
function pickStock(id){const s=S.stock.find(x=>x.id===id);V.ses.stock_id=id;if(s){V.ses.product=s.name;V.ses.lote=s.lote||'';V.ses.validade=s.validade||'';}render();}
function ptSum(){const g={};V.ses.points.forEach(p=>{g[p.t]=(g[p.t]||0)+(+p.q||0);});const e=Object.entries(g);return e.length?e.map(([t,q])=>`${PT[t][0]}: ${(+q.toFixed(2)).toString().replace('.',',')} ${PU[t]}`).join(' · '):'Nenhum ponto marcado.';}
function ptList(){return V.ses.points.map((p,i)=>`<div class="prow"><i style="background:${PT[p.t][1]}"></i><b>#${i+1}</b><span>${PT[p.t][0]}</span><input type="number" step="0.05" min="0" value="${p.q}" oninput="setPtQ(${i},this.value)"><small>${PU[p.t]}</small><button class="icon sm" onclick="rmPt(${i})" aria-label="Remover ponto">${ic('x',14)}</button></div>`).join('')+`<p class="hint" id="psum">${ptSum()}</p>`;}
function faceSvg(pts,act){
  const dots=pts.map((p,i)=>`<g><circle cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="7.5" fill="${PT[p.t][1]}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="${p.x}" y="${p.y+3}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" font-weight="800" fill="#fff">${i+1}</text></g>`).join('');
